correctness.rationale: Exact signed-resolvent elimination gives r^+=F/(2QA) with A strictly positive. The polynomial numerator has degree at most m and positive value at zero; every extra positive component consumes at least two roots counted with multiplicity. Partial fractions at the prescribed negative poles and equality at zero prove the universal sharp interpolation formula. A strictly convex positive quadratic potential realizes the coefficients with r=Q=1. The explicit two-mode rational step is independently checked by exact fractions. This proves all finite-dimensional quantifiers; numerical tests are diagnostic only.

value.rationale: The natural safe-stepsize set for an energy-stable original SAV time discretization is not necessarily an initial interval; any finite number of separated positive windows is possible despite globally positive strictly convex energies. The sharp bound by distinct active spectral modes and prescribed-threshold converse supply an exact structural classification useful for designing safe step-size search and diagnosing sign failures. This is substantially more than a renaming, scalar sign-loss example, or one-parameter recomputation.
